items.exampleEn: The mechanic fixed my bike in ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 修車師傅十分鐘就修好了我的腳踏車。

items.exampleEn: Our accountant checks the company's money every month.
items.exampleZh: 我們的會計師每個月檢查公司的帳目。

items.exampleEn: Being unemployed can make people feel bored and lonely.
items.exampleZh: 失業可能讓人覺得無聊又孤單。

items.exampleEn: The vacancy was filled in just two days.
items.exampleZh: 這個職缺兩天內就補上了。

items.exampleEn: His career as a singer lasted thirty years.
items.exampleZh: 他當歌手的職業生涯持續了三十年。

items.exampleEn: Taking care of a pet is a big responsibility.
items.exampleZh: 照顧寵物是很大的責任。

items.exampleEn: Who will be responsible if something goes wrong?
items.exampleZh: 如果出了問題，誰要負責？

items.exampleEn: A good reputation takes years to build.
items.exampleZh: 好名聲需要好幾年才能建立。

items.audioEn: We have a vacancy for an accountant, so please send your CV by the end of the month.
items.audioZh: 我們有一個會計師的職缺，請在月底前寄來履歷。
options: Someone to work as an accountant.

items.sentenceEn: He has been unemployed since March.
She has a lot of responsibility at work.
items.sentenceZh: 她在工作上有很多責任。

items.stemEn: My car broke down, so I called a ____.
items.stemZh: 我的車拋錨了，所以我打電話找修車師傅。

items.stemEn: Parents are ____ for their children's safety.
items.stemZh: 父母要為孩子的安全負責。

items.passageEn: My cousin worked as an accountant for ten years, but she wanted a new career. Last spring, she saw a vacancy at a small car repair shop and decided to become a mechanic. The shop offered her paid training. At first, her family was worried, but the shop has a good reputation, and the owner is very kind. Now she is responsible for the shop's computers as well as the cars. She says the new responsibility makes her happy. Her friend, who was unemployed for a year, also got a job there.
items.passageZh: 我的表親當了十年的會計師，但她想換個職業。去年春天，她看到一家小修車廠的職缺，決定去當修車技師。修車廠提供她支薪的訓練。一開始她的家人很擔心，但這家店的名聲很好，老闆也很親切。現在她除了修車，也負責店裡的電腦。她說新的責任讓她很開心。她一位失業了一年的朋友也在那裡找到了工作。

questions.questionZh: 她現在除了修車還負責什麼？

referenceEn: He plans to change his career.
He is planning to change careers.
rubricZh: career 表示「職業、生涯」，例如 change careers 等說法
時態配合內容（例如 plan to、be planning to 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 reputation 造一個句子，說說你知道的某家店或某個人的名聲。
referenceEn: The bakery near my home has a great reputation.
My teacher has a reputation for being very fair.
rubricZh: reputation 表示「名聲、聲譽」，例如 have a good reputation 等說法
說的是自己知道的人或店（例如 my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
